note: Arms for the model-based EASR evaluation; controllers come from pair/controllers.py (B0/B1 have none and differ only in the agent prompt).

B7_repair_v1.note: Repair v1 (dependency validation + effective write + post-commit recheck) with one implementation defect fixed: the fresh copy of the edit form is read from the largest form, not the page's first form (MantisBT's navigation jump form). See CP6.

TB_entity_occ.note: entity-level optimistic concurrency as shipped by the application (SuiteCRM's optimistic lock, MantisBT's last_updated check); unsupported for the shop's basket and account forms and for BreakingWeb

TB_field_cas.note: server-side effective write and field-level compare-and-set (apps/crm/custom/include/PairWorld.php, apps/mantis/world)

TB_integrated.note: field_cas plus semantic predicates on the dependency values the agent saw (client attaches, application enforces); shop: predicates on product price for basket updates only (no field CAS for basket lines)

CQ_extra_dep.note: EASR with a wrong extra decision dependency (the untouched field)

CQ_missing_dep.note: EASR without the task's decision dependency in its contract

EASR_v2_1_1.note: v2.1.1 fix (declared 2026-10-21): v2.1's post-commit check on the SPA JSON save path stopped waiting once the save request reached its handler, before the handler had recorded its result, and then skipped the check (race; model-free probe tests/easr/bw_postcheck_probe.py). Same mechanism otherwise. Used for the fault-suite rerun; the frozen arms keep v2.1. B4 (verify_only) shares the path but never missed its check (no read inside the handler; 0 of 540 SPA commits across cohorts), so it is not rerun; A6 has no post-commit check, so v2.1.1 does not change it.
